tables.name: users
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
 email VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
 status ENUM('active','suspended') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
 auth_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 setup_token_hash CHAR(64) NULL,
 setup_expires_at DATETIME NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables.name: user_settings
constraints: FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_settings (
 user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED PRIMARY KEY,
 language ENUM('en','es') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en',
 timezone VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'America/Bogota',
 theme ENUM('light','dark') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'light',

 FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

tables.name: habit_categories

columns.name: scope_key
columns.definition: BIGINT UNSIGNED GENERATED ALWAYS AS (COALESCE(owner_user_id,0)) STORED

constraints: FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS habit_categories (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 owner_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
 translation_key VARCHAR(50) NULL,
 description TEXT NOT NULL,
 icon VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sparkles',
 color CHAR(7) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#B8A4D4',
 scope_key BIGINT UNSIGNED GENERATED ALWAYS AS (COALESCE(owner_user_id,0)) STORED,
 created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 UNIQUE KEY category_unique(scope_key,name),
 FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables.name: routines
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS routines (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 owner_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 category_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 name VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL,
 description TEXT NOT NULL,
 start_date DATE NOT NULL,
 end_date DATE NULL,
 source_key VARCHAR(150) NULL,
 UNIQUE(owner_user_id,source_key),
 FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
 FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES habit_categories(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

tables.name: habits

columns.name: updated_at
columns.definition: TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS habits (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 owner_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 category_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 routine_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 name VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL,
 description TEXT NOT NULL,
 goal DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 unit VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 schedule_days VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]',
 scheduled_time TIME NULL,
 start_date DATE NOT NULL,
 end_date DATE NULL,
 status ENUM('active','archived') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
 section VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 sort_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 source_key VARCHAR(190) NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 UNIQUE(owner_user_id,source_key),
 INDEX owner_category(owner_user_id,category_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
 FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES habit_categories(id),
 FOREIGN KEY(routine_id) REFERENCES routines(id),
 CHECK(goal > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

tables.name: habit_completions

columns.name: updated_at
columns.definition: TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS habit_completions (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 habit_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 completed_on DATE NOT NULL,
 amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
 goal_at_time DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
 note VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 UNIQUE(habit_id,user_id,completed_on),
 INDEX user_date(user_id,completed_on),
 FOREIGN KEY(habit_id) REFERENCES habits(id),
 FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
 CHECK(amount >= 0),
 CHECK(goal_at_time > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

columns.name: active_resource
columns.definition: VARCHAR(50) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN status IN ('pending','accepted') THEN CONCAT(IF(habit_id IS NULL,'c','h'),COALESCE(habit_id,category_id)) ELSE NULL END) STORED

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS habit_shares (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 owner_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 recipient_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 habit_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 category_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 permission ENUM('viewer','participant','editor') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'viewer',
 progress_visibility ENUM('none','summary','detailed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
 include_future TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 status ENUM('pending','accepted','declined','revoked') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
 invitation_message TEXT NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 responded_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
 active_resource VARCHAR(50) GENERATED ALWAYS AS
  (CASE WHEN status IN ('pending','accepted') THEN CONCAT(IF(habit_id IS NULL,'c','h'),COALESCE(habit_id,category_id)) ELSE NULL END) STORED,
 UNIQUE KEY active_invitation(owner_user_id,recipient_user_id,active_resource),
 FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
 FOREIGN KEY(recipient_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
 FOREIGN KEY(habit_id) REFERENCES habits(id),
 FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES habit_categories(id),
 CHECK((habit_id IS NULL) <> (category_id IS NULL)),
 CHECK(owner_user_id <> recipient_user_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invitation_receipts (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,

 progress_visibility ENUM('none','summary','detailed') NOT NULL,
 include_future TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

 invitation_message TEXT NULL,

tables.name: diagrams
constraints: CONSTRAINT fk_diagrams_owner FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE diagrams (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    owner_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    client_key CHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE KEY uq_diagram_create (owner_user_id, client_key),
    KEY ix_diagrams_owner_updated (owner_user_id, updated_at),
    CONSTRAINT fk_diagrams_owner FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_name CHECK (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(name)) > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables.name: diagram_nodes

columns.name: node_key
columns.definition: VARCHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL

columns.name: parent_key
columns.definition: VARCHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL

constraints: CONSTRAINT fk_diagram_nodes_diagram FOREIGN KEY (diagram_id) REFERENCES diagrams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CONSTRAINT fk_diagram_nodes_parent FOREIGN KEY (diagram_id, parent_key) REFERENCES diagram_nodes(diagram_id, node_key)
CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_node_layout CHECK (layout_mode IS NULL OR layout_mode IN ('free','horizontal','vertical','list','topdown','linear','radial','matrix'))
CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_node_direction CHECK (layout_direction IS NULL OR layout_direction IN ('auto','clockwise','left','right','top','bottom','manual'))
CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_node_vertical CHECK (layout_vertical IS NULL OR layout_vertical IN ('auto','compact','alternating','top','bottom'))
CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_node_horizontal CHECK (layout_horizontal IS NULL OR layout_horizontal IN ('auto','ltr','rtl'))
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE diagram_nodes (
    diagram_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    node_key VARCHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
    parent_key VARCHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
    text VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    sort_order SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    layout_mode VARCHAR(16) NULL,
    layout_direction VARCHAR(16) NULL,
    layout_vertical VARCHAR(16) NULL,
    layout_horizontal VARCHAR(8) NULL,
    position_x DECIMAL(12,2) NULL,
    position_y DECIMAL(12,2) NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (diagram_id, node_key),
    KEY ix_diagram_nodes_parent (diagram_id, parent_key),
    CONSTRAINT fk_diagram_nodes_diagram FOREIGN KEY (diagram_id) REFERENCES diagrams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_diagram_nodes_parent FOREIGN KEY (diagram_id, parent_key) REFERENCES diagram_nodes(diagram_id, node_key),
    CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_node_text CHECK (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(text)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_node_layout CHECK (layout_mode IS NULL OR layout_mode IN ('free','horizontal','vertical','list','topdown','linear','radial','matrix')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_node_direction CHECK (layout_direction IS NULL OR layout_direction IN ('auto','clockwise','left','right','top','bottom','manual')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_node_vertical CHECK (layout_vertical IS NULL OR layout_vertical IN ('auto','compact','alternating','top','bottom')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_diagram_node_horizontal CHECK (layout_horizontal IS NULL OR layout_horizontal IN ('auto','ltr','rtl'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
